title: HUD and minimap
summary: Every HUD box, the HUD editor, the minimap, the world map and the look-at and info boxes.

s.x: The SkyRPG HUD is a set of small boxes drawn over the game: your purse, your skill progress, a health bar, the minimap and more. Every box can be moved, resized or hidden, and each shows only when it has something to say. This page lists them all, explains the HUD editor, and covers the minimap, the world map and the info boxes from the Utilities mod.

s.x: Boxes pin to the nearest third of the screen, so your layout keeps its shape when you resize the window. Each box also has its own on and off switch in Settings under HUD.
The minimap is a small map of your surroundings in the top right.
It shows the blocks around you, in the colour of their own textures, so paths, roofs and flowers are visible.
Other players are shown as their faces and you are an arrow.
NPCs and your waypoints appear as icons.
. There are five levels, from a quarter of a pixel per block to four pixels per block. The zoom is remembered for each dimension. In the hub it starts zoomed in.

Waypoints outside the view show as an arrow on the rim.
The minimap can be switched off in Settings under Map.
